## Summary

Tweet (verbatim, complete per fxtwitter — 91 chars):

> Tired of AI that says "I can't help with that"?
>
> Unaligned GLM-5.3 gives straight answers.

Pure product one-liner: Unaligned sells access to an "unaligned" (refusal-removed) build of GLM-5.3, positioned against mainstream assistants' refusals. The tweet carries no link, no benchmark, no demo — the pitch is the entire payload.

## Why it matters

- **The product category is real and growing.** GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's open-weights model (MIT licence), so third parties freely publish "abliterated" variants: refusal-direction weight orthogonalization (no adapter, no runtime filter), e.g. dealignai's FP8 build (MMLU 87.3 vs base 86.7 — capability within noise) and OrcaRouter's (HarmBench refusals 0.933 → 0.180). Multiple providers now serve such variants at ~$0.15/$0.50 per 1M tokens (Experiential Labs, Secret Chat AI, OrcaRouter, others surveyed by Franz Geffck, Nov 2026). Unaligned is the consumer/chat+API face of the same trend for DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi.
- **Relevance to the stack here:** pay-per-token open-model chat + API is exactly the lane this household runs on (local/API LLM agents). If refusal behavior ever blocks a legitimate workflow, abliterated open-weight variants are the fallback that doesn't require changing model class.

Skepticism gates:
- "Straight answers" is marketing, not measurement — the tweet offers no eval. Abliteration removes refusals, it does not improve reasoning; one provider's own card admits "refusal is reduced, not removed."
- "Unaligned" ≠ anything goes: every listed provider keeps a hard floor (CSAM, terrorism, real threats) and the serving provider can still refuse under its own rules.
- Third-party weight edits are unaudited artifacts; privacy/retention claims across this market are self-attested and unaudited (some providers don't even publish an entity). Vet before sending anything sensitive.
- Unaligned itself (the app in the tweet) published no method details at capture — which weights, which ablation scope, what retention: unknown from the tweet alone.
